desc:
🎲 A cute and lively Yut Nori you can enjoy together! 🐾
Play the traditional Korean board game Yut Nori, now easily on Roblox!

Throw the Yut sticks, move your pieces,
and feel the thrill of catching — and getting caught — by your opponents! 😆
With adorable visuals and bouncy animations,
anyone can jump in and have fun without pressure ✨

Play with friends, family,
or jump into a random match for a quick round! 🔥

Sound Effects: MPooman

-

🎲 How are Yut results decided?
In this game, the Yut sticks have no preset results and no probability manipulation.

"The strength of your throw"
"How the Yut sticks spin in the air"
"How they bounce and roll after hitting the ground"

All of these are calculated in real time by the Roblox physics engine.
So even if you throw with the same strength, the result can change every time.
This makes it feel very close to real-life Yut Nori.
